images.name: smoke-residue
images.scene: A close three-quarter view of a kitchen cabinet door and the wall beside it, both carrying a visible grey-brown smoke film. A gloved hand holds a dry chemical sponge and has wiped one clean stripe through the residue, revealing original paint colour against the soiled surface. Ordinary kitchen, dim indoor light, no window glare.
